question:
A transformer has $500$ turns in the primary coil and $2500$ turns in the secondary coil. The primary coil is connected to a $220\text{ V}$ AC supply.
(i) Explain the working principle of a transformer using Faraday’s law of induction.
(ii) Calculate the secondary voltage and state whether the transformer is step-up or step-down.

options.A:
(i) A transformer works because constant DC flux directly induces a constant secondary emf.
(ii) $V_s=44\text{ V}$; it is a step-down transformer.
options.B:
(i) A transformer works by electrostatic induction between coils.
(ii) $V_s=550\text{ V}$; it is a step-down transformer.
options.C:
(i) AC in the primary produces changing core flux, which induces secondary emf according to Faraday’s law.
(ii) $V_s=V_p\dfrac{N_s}{N_p}=220\times\dfrac{2500}{500}=1100\text{ V}$. Since $N_s>N_p$, it is a step-up transformer.
options.D:
(i) Transformer action depends only on resistance of the windings and not on changing magnetic flux.
(ii) $V_s=110\text{ V}$; it is a step-up transformer.
